test_position_control: test the locobot arm joint position control by setting target joint angles and verifying accuracy
test_ee_pose_control: test the locobot arm end-effector pose control using position and orientation in rotation matrix or quaternion form
test_ee_pitch_control: test the locobot arm end-effector pitch and roll control by setting target position with pitch and roll angles
test_ee_xyz_control: test the locobot arm end-effector XYZ displacement control by moving the arm by a specified offset vector
test_gripper_control: test the locobot gripper open and close commands and verify the gripper state returns expected values
